findings.title: Provision is governed access rather than autonomous possession

findings.reader_payoff: The recipient's relation to food becomes one of dependent use under conditions, rather than absolute self-ownership.
findings.containment: This is a qualified global social and ecological resonance; it does not build a full economic doctrine or erase the immediate eating command.
